rows.vgi.doc_llm: Read-only NBA, WNBA, and NBA G League data from the official NBA Stats API and NBA/WNBA CDNs, in three schemas: nba, wnba, and gleague, each with the same tables and functions. current_* tables give live standings, today's scoreboard, the season schedule, teams, players, and per-game player and team statistics. Functions take a season as its start year (2025 = 2025-26 for NBA and G League, 2025 for WNBA) and cover standings, scoreboards by date, rosters, season and advanced statistics, leaderboards, league and player game logs, careers, box scores, and play-by-play. Game IDs are 10-digit text.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
# NBA, WNBA, and G League basketball data

Query current and historical basketball data from SQL. Each league is its own schema (`nba`, `wnba`, `gleague`) with the same surface: standings, scores, schedules, teams, rosters, player and team statistics, leaderboards, game logs, careers, box scores, and play-by-play.

## Data source

Data is fetched on demand from the NBA's public Stats API and content CDN; nothing is stored or rehosted. NBA data is for personal, non-commercial use under the NBA.com Terms of Use. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the NBA, WNBA, or NBA G League.
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"name": "nba_teams_are_populated", "description": "The NBA has thirty active teams with stable identifiers.", "sql": "SELECT count(*) = 30 AS thirty_teams FROM nba.nba.current_teams", "expected_result": [{"thirty_teams": true}]}, {"name": "wnba_franchises_include_summaries", "description": "Every active WNBA team has an all-time franchise summary row.", "sql": "SELECT count(*) >= 13 AS populated FROM nba.wnba.franchise_history WHERE row_kind = 'franchise'", "expected_result": [{"populated": true}]}, {"name": "historical_standings_balance", "description": "Final 2025-26 NBA standings: 30 teams whose wins equal their losses in total.", "sql": "SELECT count(*) = 30 AND sum(wins) = sum(losses) AS balanced FROM nba.nba.standings(season := 2025)", "expected_result": [{"balanced": true}]}, {"name": "box_score_points_match_scoreboard", "description": "A completed game's player points sum to the published final score.", "sql": "SELECT (SELECT sum(points) FROM nba.nba.box_score('0022600201')) = (SELECT home_score + away_score FROM nba.nba.scoreboard(DATE '2026-11-08') WHERE game_id = '0022600201') AS consistent", "expected_result": [{"consistent": true}]}]
